record.question: What camps, toilets, water sources and parking are available along the approach?
record.reason: Historical western and northern trailhead facilities now include Crabtree, Kennedy and Sonora restrooms, Kennedy water faucets and separately identified Eagle/Coyote horse camps. Current operation, water safety, individual campsites, facility coordinates, approach campgrounds and operator booking inventory remain unresolved. Kennedy camping/fee conflicts and the distinction between Eagle trailhead and horse-camp facilities require recheck.
